reviews.title: Excellent and rapidly improving
reviews.pros:
Sleek, clear, intuitive and very effective to play back to stakeholders.

It forms an architectural repository of artefacts in the background that is very useful to visualise progression of the systems.
reviews.cons: the versioning when I used it was somewhat clunky but they listened to our complaints and improved it
reviews.overall: changing tools as an architect can be fraught with problems, however the transition to IcePanel was relatively smooth and the team were up and running very rapidly
